name: Firebase Authentication
solves: Provides Firebase Authentication via the Firebase JS SDK (`firebase` / `firebase/auth`) for email/password, phone, anonymous, and federated identity providers, with tight integration to other Firebase products and multi-platform clients.
best_for: Apps already on Firebase (Firestore, Cloud Functions, Hosting) that want auth in the same Google cloud stack
Mobile + web products needing shared identity across Firebase client SDKs
Teams that want Google-managed identity with social providers and phone auth without running an IdP
Prototypes and products that benefit from Firebase's generous free tier and console UX
Projects that need anonymous auth upgrading to permanent accounts
skip_when: You must keep user credentials and session stores entirely self-hosted with no Google dependency
You need fine-grained B2B organization SSO/SCIM as the primary product (consider WorkOS/Clerk)
Your backend is not using Firebase and you only need a thin JWT library
Vendor lock-in to Google Cloud identity is unacceptable for procurement or data residency reasons
You want open-source Auth.js/Better Auth with your own Postgres user table as source of truth
